newsitem.title: USA: SFG names Gary Templeton president, CEO.
newsitem.headline: SFG names Gary Templeton president, CEO.

text.p: SFG Corp said Friday it named Gary Templeton president and chief executive.
He replaces John Dugan, who was recently named chairman. Dugan replaced Martin Goldstein, who resigned.
Templeton was previously vice president of business development of Andrea Electronics Corp.
SFG also said it executed a letter of intent to buy Retail Broadcasting System Inc in exchange for up to 1.5 million shares of its stock.
SFG said that to complete the merger and implement its business plan, it must raise up to $750,000 through an offering of units of SFG common stock and warrants.
SFG said Retail Broadcasting would become its wholly owned subsidiary. It expects to complete the merger October 1.
When the merger was completed, SFG would change its name to Retail Broadcasting Group Inc.
SFG said Retail Broadcasting is a new company in the business of installing and operating broadcast advertising displays in retail chains.
